title: Shrinking odd-inverse width is a new fan-follower Diophantine obstruction
statement: The odd inverse interval has width ~ (2/3) y^{-1/3}, so for large y the width is < 1 and the odd predecessor is unique. A long O-dominated trajectory therefore has essentially zero backward branching, and an infinite fan-follower requires infinitely many exact integer hits of these shrinking nonlinear inverse intervals — a new obstruction, stricter than a forward parity census.
counterexamples: width < 1 for every y >= 1 (y=1 already has width 2^{2/3}-1 ≈ 0.587); uniqueness is odd_cell_unique for all y, not a large-y threshold
every odd x makes T(x) Type 2 with occupant x (named 3,37,365,761); forward infinite hits are tautological
9 --OOE--> 11 occupies a real hull of width 0.221 < 1 (archived juggler_cycle_inverse_width)
hug/fan words are OE/OOE; existing hug-flow ledger is net positive (+5λ/12, +7λ/24); 17/44 existing 19-endpoints are already odd
mathematical_domain: Juggler descent-free flights / odd inverse cells
notes: Phase 0 only. Width is the MVT expansion of the odd cell. The boxed infinite-hit slogan is a quantifier reversal of a realized odd letter plus the priced O-pullback. No hug-cylinder rerun, no fan-concat n-window, no Lean, no Paper A, no ledger theorem row. Not a halt theorem.
tested_range: y=10^k for k=0..12; width scan y<=1e5; 80-point windows at 10^2..10^6; ambient Types y<=4000; odd hits {3,37,365,761}; existing hug-flow and fan-concat artifacts
